interpretation: post-hoc exploratory reanalysis; not original confirmatory family
effect: DA minus FHS5; positive time and negative risk are favorable
rng: Python random.Random seeded by SHA256 of seed|phase|node_count|replicate|model; randrange(20) 20 times per stratum; indices shared across both metrics
quantile: inverse empirical CDF nearest rank ceil(B*p), one-based; no interpolation
weights: seven traces equally within parent; twenty parents equally within model; three model means equally; phases and node sizes never pooled
precision: integer bootstrap numerators and exact rational denominators; floats for display only
limitations: Nominal Bonferroni family level 95 percent across these 16 intervals only; not finite-sample exact bootstrap coverage.
Does not extend the original 40-comparison family or use its gates.
Both phases were previously inspected; agreement is post-hoc cross-phase consistency, not new preregistered confirmation.
A degenerate interval at zero is not proof of population equivalence.
This compares trained topology-initialization schemes, not an isolated causal topology effect.
